name: nested-feature-selection-v1
question: What is the smallest handcrafted subset that retains 90% of the full model's January human-domain MAE gain over material?

inner_selection.method: greedy forward selection beginning with material
inner_selection.stopping_rule: smallest path subset retaining 90% of the full-model MAE gain over material

lock_rule: Upper-median selected feature count; rank features by selection frequency, then mean selected rank, then name.
